name.text: Finding Trigonometric Ratios in a Right-Angled Triangle

questiontext.text:
The right-angled triangle \(ABC\) below has a right angle at \(B\). The side \(AB\) has length \({@AB@}\) and the side \(BC\) has length \({@BC@}\).

Find the exact values of \(\sin \theta\), \(\cos \theta\), and \(\tan \theta\). Enter exact values, using e.g. sqrt(2) for \(\sqrt{2}\).

[[jsxgraph]] /* Triangle drawn to the true proportions of this variant. */ var ab = {#AB#}; /* vertical leg AB (opposite theta) */ var bc = {#BC#}; /* horizontal leg BC (adjacent), always the longer leg */ var s = 5 / bc; /* scale the longer leg to 5 board units */ var w = bc * s; var h = ab * s; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-1.4, h + 0.9, w + 1.3, -1.0], axis: false, keepaspectratio: true, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false }); var B = board.create('point', [0, 0], {name: 'B', fixed: true, visible: false, label: {offset: [-15, -12], visible: true}}); var C = board.create('point', [w, 0], {name: 'C', fixed: true, visible: false, label: {offset: [10, -12], visible: true}}); var A = board.create('point', [0, h], {name: 'A', fixed: true, visible: false, label: {offset: [-15, 10], visible: true}}); board.create('segment', [B, C]); board.create('segment', [B, A]); board.create('segment', [A, C]); /* Right-angle mark at B */ board.create('angle', [C, B, A], {radius: 0.35, type: 'square', name: ''}); /* Angle theta at C */ board.create('angle', [A, C, B], {radius: 0.6, name: 'θ'}); /* Side-length labels, anchored away from the segments */ board.create('text', [-0.25, h / 2, '{#AB#}'], {anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'middle', fixed: true}); board.create('text', [w / 2, -0.35, '{#BC#}'], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fixed: true}); [[/jsxgraph]]

generalfeedback.text:
In a right-angled triangle the three trigonometric ratios are defined relative to the angle (SOH-CAH-TOA): sine is the ratio of the side opposite the angle to the hypotenuse, cosine is the adjacent side over the hypotenuse, and tangent is the opposite side over the adjacent side. Here \(AB\) is opposite \(\theta\), \(BC\) is adjacent to \(\theta\), and the hypotenuse is \(AC\).

Only the hypotenuse needs to be calculated. By Pythagoras' theorem, \[AC = \sqrt{AB^2 + BC^2} = \sqrt{{@AB@}^2 + {@BC@}^2} = {@AC@}.\] The trigonometric ratios are then \begin{align*}\sin(\theta) &= \frac{AB}{AC} = \frac{{@AB@}}{{@AC@}} = {@ta1@},\\ \cos(\theta) &= \frac{BC}{AC} = \frac{{@BC@}}{{@AC@}} = {@ta2@}, \ \text{and}\\ \tan(\theta) &= \frac{AB}{BC} = \frac{{@AB@}}{{@BC@}} = {@ta3@}.\end{align*}

prtcorrect.text: Correct answer, well done.

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

node.description: Diagnostic: did the student use the adjacent side (i.e. give the cosine)?

truefeedback.text: You appear to have used the adjacent side in your ratio. For sine, use the side opposite the angle: \(\sin\theta = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}\). Look at the diagram again: which of the two labelled sides does not touch the angle \(\theta\)?

falsefeedback.text: First find the hypotenuse \(AC\) using Pythagoras' theorem, then use \(\sin\theta = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}\) (the SOH in SOH-CAH-TOA). The side opposite \(\theta\) is the one that does not touch the angle.

The cosine ratio is \(\cos\theta = \dfrac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}\) (the CAH in SOH-CAH-TOA). The adjacent side runs from \(\theta\) to the right angle, and the hypotenuse — found by Pythagoras' theorem — is the side opposite the right angle.

node.description: Diagnostic: reciprocal of the tangent ratio (adjacent over opposite)?

truefeedback.text: This is the reciprocal of the required ratio: you have divided the adjacent side by the opposite side. The tangent ratio is \(\tan\theta = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}\) — check which way up your fraction should be.

falsefeedback.text: Use \(\tan\theta = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}\) (the TOA in SOH-CAH-TOA). Note that the hypotenuse is not involved: both sides in the ratio are given directly in the diagram.

qtest.description: All three ratios correct: full marks on every part.
Targeted wrong answers: sin/cos swapped in part 1; cosine given as sine in part 2 (generic wrong); reciprocal tangent in part 3.
Generic wrong answers that match no diagnostic: catch-all branches fire.
